# Prune Hill Capital

> Prune Hill Capital is a student-led, non-profit investment fund at Royal Holloway, University of London Business School (Egham, Surrey, UK). Students research, pitch and manage a real, ESG-screened portfolio under a formal Investment Mandate (v1.2, 2026-27), with oversight from an Academic Adviser and an Advisory Board. Tagline: "Learn investing by doing it."

- Chief Investment Officer: Hugo Christie (chairs the Investment Committee)
- Academic Adviser: Julinda Nuri
- Head of Research: Manjit Singh
- Risk & Compliance Officer: Christa Shaji
- Operations & Reporting Officer: Veer Shinh
- Portfolio Managers: Kiana Advani, John Carlo Sigua, Aaryan Patel, Henry Bates-Hawkesworth, Milan Toohey
- Recruiting: Equity Analyst / Portfolio Manager, open to all enrolled Royal Holloway students, no finance background required
- Non-profit: no member receives personal financial benefit; once at scale, up to 30% of realised net profits may go to RHUL hardship support
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/prune-hill-capital
